name: billcom
description: Accounts payable and receivable via Bill.com AP/AR MCP (vendors, bills, payments, invoices, customers).

BILL_DEV_KEY.description: Developer Key from Settings → Sync & Integrations → Manage Developer Keys

BILL_USERNAME.description: Sync Token Name (or user email when BILL_AUTH_TYPE=full_access)

BILL_PASSWORD.description: Sync Token Value (or user password when BILL_AUTH_TYPE=full_access)

BILL_ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Organization ID starting with 008 (shown on Sync & Integrations)

BILL_ENVIRONMENT.description: Bill.com API environment: production or sandbox

BILL_AUTH_TYPE.description: Auth mode: sync_token (default, read/sync), full_access (payments/send), or session_token

BILL_SESSION_TOKEN.description: Pre-authenticated session token; required only when BILL_AUTH_TYPE=session_token
